title: MPhil/PhD Data, Networks and Society
institution: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
about: LSE's MPhil/PhD Data, Networks and Society for 2027/28 entry. The application and funding deadline is 13 January 2027; applications and supporting documents submitted by then are considered for LSE PhD Studentships and ESRC funding.
requirements: Minimum entry: a high merit (68%) in a taught master's in social science or humanities, normally with a distinction in the dissertation
Research proposal of no more than 2,500 words
Application and all supporting documents must be submitted by the deadline to be considered for funding

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research proposal of no more than 2,500 words" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Research proposal of no more than 2,500 words" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
